external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Michele has over 15 years of experience as a socio-cultural educator and project developer in the third sector. He works with organisations focused on human rights, childhood and adolescence, collaborating on national and international projects with entities such as Save the Children and Caritas Italiana. He has international volunteering experience in Africa and Central-Eastern Europe and contributes to the organisation with expertise in educational methodologies, human rights-based approaches
